    export

    • export(options: ExportOptions): Promise<Blob>

      Serialize the current in-memory dataset to a browser Blob.

      Always emits full-detail geometry; the source's render-time LOD interval is restored before the promise resolves.

      • geojson / topojson — single-file output, returned as application/json
      • shapefile — multi-file output (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj), returned as a single application/zip Blob packed via fflate

      Parameters

      • options: ExportOptions

        options accepts ExportOptions for export. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to ExportOptions.

      Returns Promise<Blob>

    getDataset

    • getDataset(): MapshaperDataset | undefined

      Returns the live mapshaper dataset reference owned by this source.

      Do not mutate the returned object directly. Edit-history caches (arc-flag flags, Flatbush spatial indices, the LOD copy in DisplayArcs) key off (layer, shape, arc) identity and shape/arc counts; mutations applied outside the official edit-command surface will silently desync those caches. To change a dataset, route the change through Emap.ops.* (clip / dissolve / buffer / …), Emap.editSession.* (translate / rotate / scale), or a custom EditCommand. Read-only inspection — getDataset()?.info?.crs_string, dataset.layers[0].name, arc iteration via dataset.arcs.getArcIter() — is always safe.

      The TypeScript return type intentionally stays MapshaperDataset (not Readonly<MapshaperDataset>) because mapshaper's own internal helpers — and a number of in-tree edit commands — receive the dataset and mutate it through trusted code paths. A blanket Readonly would just force casts everywhere.

      Returns MapshaperDataset | undefined

      • Defined in src/source/source.ts:58

    OptionalgetSimplifyFloor

    • getSimplifyFloor?(): number

      Sticky simplification floor (in arc-Z units). Set by the most recent -simplify run via setDataset; cleared on a fresh load. The render loop uses this as a lower-bound for setRetainedInterval so the per-frame zoom-LOD never re-introduces detail the user filtered out.

      Returns number

      • Defined in src/source/source.ts:85

    refreshDisplayArcs

    • refreshDisplayArcs(): void

      Eagerly re-initialize the LOD copy in DisplayArcs from the current dataset arcs. Use for one-shot mutations that need the new copy ready immediately. Per-frame in-place edits (drag sessions) should prefer markDisplayArcsDirty to defer the rebuild until the renderer actually needs the filtered copy.

      Returns void
